config.label: Folder for this board's autosave and named saves, used as given (PI_MATH_BOARD_DATA_DIR, the old name, also works)
config.description: Folder for this board's autosave and named saves, used as given (PI_MATH_BOARD_DATA_DIR, the old name, also works). Default: the mcp/ subfolder of the board's data folder. A plain checkout keeps lessons in <package>/.data; an npm or npx install uses a per-user folder: ~/Library/Application Support/math-board on macOS, $XDG_STATE_HOME/math-board or ~/.local/state/math-board on Linux, %LOCALAPPDATA%\math-board on Windows.
